title: Maximum Number of Words You Can Type
description: Count the number of words that can be typed given a set of broken letters.
pseudocode:
1. Split text into words
2. Initialize count = 0
3. For each word in words:
4.   Check if any char in word is in brokenLetters
5.   If not, increment count
6. Return count

steps.note: Processing first word: 'hello'. Checking if any char is in 'ad'.
Checking 'hello': None of 'h','e','l','l','o' are in 'ad'. Word is typable.
Word 'hello' is typable. Increment count to 1.
Processing second word: 'world'. Checking if any char is in 'ad'.
Checking 'world': Char 'd' is in 'ad'. Word is not typable.
